public_gates: run M399 base reset zero-current and zero-action ablations on M457 config
use source-diverse seed windows rather than a single 16-episode smoke
report aggregate success return termination and clearance deltas
decide whether to mine matched-current rows or redesign again
forbidden_shortcuts: do not change actor input/output contract
do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not claim self-ID from aggregate success alone
hypothesis: The M457 late-reveal config may create more useful response/history ablation differences than the M451 robust configs, but this must be tested on source-diverse seeds before matched-current mining or training.
success_criteria: all planned ablation benchmarks complete without scenario sampling failure
results cover at least three seed windows
documentation reports whether ablation deltas are strong enough for matched-current mining
failure_criteria: benchmark is only a single small smoke
results are interpreted as self-ID proof without intervention/matched-current evidence

commands.name: late_reveal_ablation_benchmark
commands.command: Evaluate M399 base reset-recurrent zero-current-response and zero-action-history on the M457 config across seed windows; no training.

decision_rule: M458 can admit matched-current mining if source-diverse ablation deltas are useful. It cannot promote a checkpoint.
